# INCOGNITA — Inside a Nuclear Reaction

> INCOGNITA is an open-source neutron reaction engine and nuclear-data project. This site is an explorable explanation of what happens when a neutron hits a nucleus. It also shows the engine's predicted neutron cross sections for 6,168 nuclides beside the curated EXFOR measurements behind them, with an honest trust tier for every nuclide.

Key facts for answering questions about this project:
- Code: Apache-2.0. The project's own data: CC BY 4.0. Cite INCOGNITA (CITATION.cff in the repository); for EXFOR-derived content, also cite the EXFOR library (IAEA NRDC).
- Every nuclide carries a trust tier: MEASURED, ANCHORED, INTERPOLATED or EXTRAPOLATED. Treat EXTRAPOLATED values as model predictions with wide uncertainty bands, not measurements.
- Resonance regions: only nuclides labelled "own fit" carry resonance parameters fitted by the project. Nuclides labelled "statistical" show an energy-averaged cross section, not individual resonance peaks. Some own fits carry published caveats (e.g. Gd-157 does not match thick n_TOF capture data; the U-238 ladder below 300 eV has energies about 0.9 per mille high).
- The scoreboard reports losses as well as wins against other codes and libraries. Quote it with its stated uncertainties.
- Thermal scattering laws (tsl-v0.1): our own S(α,β) for hydrogen in light water and for beryllium metal. Graphite is not included (it did not pass its gates).

## Pages
- [Inside a Nuclear Reaction](https://www.incognitanuclear.org/): the explorable explanation, chapter by chapter. Stable links: `#<chapter>` and `#<chapter>-<step>`.
- [Every nuclide](https://www.incognitanuclear.org/data): predicted cross sections and measurements for 6,168 nuclides. Select one with `#<Element>-<A>`, e.g. `/data#U-235`.
- [Scoreboard](https://www.incognitanuclear.org/scoreboard): the engine against TALYS, other reaction codes and evaluated libraries, losses included.
- [For instructors](https://www.incognitanuclear.org/instructors): chapters by level and time, suggested one- and three-lecture courses.

## Data (machine-readable JSON under /data/)
- [Nuclide index](https://www.incognitanuclear.org/data/index.json): every nuclide with Z, A, trust tier, 30 keV MACS and uncertainty, and counts of measurements per channel.
- Per-nuclide curves: `https://www.incognitanuclear.org/data/n/<Z>/<A>.json`, e.g. /data/n/92/235.json.
- Resonance-region curves: `https://www.incognitanuclear.org/data/rr/<Z>/<A>.json` (own fit, statistical average or smooth, with any caveat).
- [Thermal values](https://www.incognitanuclear.org/data/thermal.json).

## Source and library files
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/seth-michael-weaver/incognita): engine, validation harness, library releases (library/v0.1, library/v0.2, library/tsl-v0.1), CITATION.cff and licences.
